name: chrome-inspector-suite
description: A suite of small, local-only Chrome MV3 inspector extensions. No backend, no tracking, no build step.

scripts.package: npm test && node tools/check-extensions.mjs && node tools/package.mjs
scripts.release: node tools/scaffold.mjs && node tools/sync-shared.mjs && node tools/make-readmes.mjs && node tools/make-listings.mjs && npm run package
